soc2-cc6-01.name: Logical Access Controls
soc2-cc6-01.description: Access to systems is restricted using RBAC and MFA.
soc2-cc6-01.remediation: Enable RBAC and MFA. Set rbac_enabled=true and mfa_enabled=true in compliance config.

soc2-cc6-02.name: Credential Rotation
soc2-cc6-02.description: Secrets and credentials are rotated at least every 90 days.
soc2-cc6-02.remediation: Configure secrets rotation to ≤90 days. Set secrets_rotation_days=90.

soc2-cc6-03.name: Session Timeout
soc2-cc6-03.description: Operator sessions expire after at most 60 minutes of inactivity.
soc2-cc6-03.remediation: Set session_timeout_minutes=60 in the server configuration.

soc2-cc6-04.name: Agent Token Expiry
soc2-cc6-04.remediation: Set agent_token_expiry_hours=24. Rotate agent tokens per run.

soc2-cc6-05.name: Minimum Credential Length
soc2-cc6-05.description: Passwords and passphrases must be at least 12 characters.
soc2-cc6-05.remediation: Enforce password_min_length=12 in the authentication configuration.

soc2-cc7-01.name: Security Event Audit Logging
soc2-cc7-01.description: All security-relevant events are captured in an append-only audit log.
soc2-cc7-01.remediation: Enable audit_logging=true. Use CompliancePreset.STANDARD or higher.

soc2-cc7-02.name: Tamper-Evident Audit Log
soc2-cc7-02.description: Audit log entries are HMAC-chained so tampering is detectable.

soc2-cc7-03.name: Audit Log Retention
soc2-cc7-03.description: Audit logs are retained for at least 365 days.
soc2-cc7-03.remediation: Retain audit segments for 365 days; the check reads the oldest segment on disk.

soc2-cc7-04.name: Log Integrity Protection
soc2-cc7-04.description: Log files are protected against unauthorised modification.

soc2-cc7-05.name: Incident Response Plan
soc2-cc7-05.description: A documented incident response plan is in place.
soc2-cc7-05.remediation: Document and store an incident response runbook under docs/incident-response.md.

soc2-cc8-01.name: Change Approval Gates
soc2-cc8-01.description: High-risk tasks require human approval before execution.

soc2-cc9-01.name: Agent Sandbox Isolation
soc2-cc9-01.description: Agents run inside containers to limit blast radius of compromise.
soc2-cc9-01.remediation: Enable container sandboxing. Use --sandbox flag or set sandbox_enabled=true.

soc2-cc9-02.name: Syscall Filtering
soc2-cc9-02.description: Seccomp-BPF profiles restrict agent processes to a minimal syscall allowlist.
soc2-cc9-02.remediation: Enable seccomp_enabled=true. Apply AgentSeccompProfile via SecurityProfile.

soc2-cc9-03.name: Vulnerability Scanning
soc2-cc9-03.description: Dependencies and container images are scanned for known CVEs.
soc2-cc9-03.remediation: Enable Trivy or Grype in CI/CD pipeline. Set vulnerability_scanning=true.

soc2-cc9-04.name: SBOM Generation
soc2-cc9-04.description: A Software Bill of Materials is produced for each task run.
soc2-cc9-04.remediation: Enable sbom_enabled=true in compliance config. Uses CycloneDX format.

iso27001-a5-01.name: Information Security Policy
iso27001-a5-01.description: An information security policy is documented and enforced.
iso27001-a5-01.remediation: Document a security policy and enforce it through RBAC and audit logging.

iso27001-a8-01.name: Asset Inventory (SBOM)
iso27001-a8-01.description: All software assets are inventoried via SBOM generation.
iso27001-a8-01.remediation: Enable sbom_enabled=true to generate CycloneDX SBOMs per run.

iso27001-a8-02.name: Data Classification
iso27001-a8-02.description: Sensitive data is classified and handled according to its classification.
iso27001-a8-02.remediation: Implement data_classification=true. Tag tasks containing PII/secrets.

iso27001-a9-01.name: Access Control Policy
iso27001-a9-01.description: Role-based access control enforces least privilege.
iso27001-a9-01.remediation: Enable RBAC. Assign minimal roles to agents and operators.

iso27001-a9-02.name: User Registration and Deprovisioning
iso27001-a9-02.description: Access rights reviews are conducted at regular intervals (≤90 days).
iso27001-a9-02.remediation: Set access_review_days=90. Schedule quarterly access reviews.

iso27001-a9-03.name: Multi-Factor Authentication
iso27001-a9-03.description: MFA is required for all operator accounts.
iso27001-a9-03.remediation: Enable MFA for all operator identities. Set mfa_enabled=true.

iso27001-a10-01.name: Cryptographic Controls
iso27001-a10-01.description: Encryption is applied to data at rest and in transit.

iso27001-a10-02.name: TLS Enforcement
iso27001-a10-02.description: All external API calls use TLS 1.2 or higher.
iso27001-a10-02.remediation: Set tls_enforced=true. Reject plaintext HTTP connections.

iso27001-a12-01.name: Operational Security Logging
iso27001-a12-01.description: Security events are logged and protected against tampering.

iso27001-a12-02.name: Malware and Vulnerability Protection
iso27001-a12-02.description: Container images and dependencies are scanned for vulnerabilities.
iso27001-a12-02.remediation: Add vulnerability scanning to CI/CD. Enable vulnerability_scanning=true.

iso27001-a12-03.name: Backup and Recovery
iso27001-a12-03.description: Encrypted backups are configured with a tested recovery procedure.
iso27001-a12-03.remediation: Enable backup_enabled=true and backup_encryption=true. Test restoration.

iso27001-a14-01.name: Secure Development
iso27001-a14-01.description: SAST and dependency scanning are integrated into the CI/CD pipeline.

iso27001-a14-02.name: Dependency Integrity
iso27001-a14-02.description: Dependencies are pinned to exact versions and verified via lock files.
iso27001-a14-02.remediation: Pin all dependencies. Use uv.lock / poetry.lock / package-lock.json.

iso27001-a16-01.name: Incident Management Process
iso27001-a16-01.description: An incident response procedure is documented and practiced.
iso27001-a16-01.remediation: Document incident response procedure. Set incident_response_plan=true.

iso27001-a17-01.name: Business Continuity and DR
iso27001-a17-01.description: Recovery Time Objective is ≤4 hours with tested DR procedures.
iso27001-a17-01.remediation: Define and test DR runbooks. Set dr_rto_hours=4.

pci-req2-01.name: Secure System Configuration
pci-req2-01.description: System components are hardened and unnecessary services are disabled.
pci-req2-01.remediation: Enable container sandboxing with dropped Linux capabilities.

pci-req3-01.name: Encryption of Stored Cardholder Data
pci-req3-01.description: Sensitive data stored at rest is encrypted using strong cryptography.
pci-req3-01.remediation: Enable encrypt_at_rest=true. Use AES-256-GCM for state files.

pci-req4-01.name: TLS for Data in Transit
pci-req4-01.description: Cardholder data is transmitted only over encrypted connections.
pci-req4-01.remediation: Enforce TLS 1.2+. Set tls_enforced=true and encrypt_in_transit=true.

pci-req6-01.name: Vulnerability Management
pci-req6-01.description: Known vulnerabilities are identified and remediated promptly.
pci-req6-01.remediation: Run Trivy/Grype in CI. Set vulnerability_scanning=true.

pci-req6-02.name: SAST in Development Pipeline
pci-req6-02.description: Static analysis is integrated into the development pipeline.
pci-req6-02.remediation: Integrate Semgrep or Bandit into CI. Set sast_in_ci=true.

pci-req7-01.name: Least Privilege Access
pci-req7-01.description: Access to system components is limited to the minimum required.
pci-req7-01.remediation: Enable RBAC and drop container capabilities to minimum required.

pci-req8-01.name: Multi-Factor Authentication
pci-req8-01.description: MFA is required for all access to the cardholder data environment.
pci-req8-01.remediation: Enforce MFA for all operator authentication. Set mfa_enabled=true.

pci-req8-02.name: Password Complexity
pci-req8-02.description: Passwords must be at least 12 characters.

pci-req10-01.name: Audit Logging of All Access
pci-req10-01.description: All access to system components is logged.

pci-req10-02.name: Audit Log Retention (12 months)
pci-req10-02.description: Audit logs are retained for at least 12 months.
pci-req10-02.remediation: Retain audit segments for 365 days; the check reads the oldest segment on disk.

pci-req11-01.name: Penetration Testing and Scanning
pci-req11-01.description: Penetration testing and vulnerability scanning are conducted regularly.
pci-req11-01.remediation: Run automated vulnerability scanning and schedule periodic penetration tests.

pci-req11-02.name: WAF Deployment
pci-req11-02.description: A web application firewall is deployed in front of public-facing systems.
pci-req11-02.remediation: Deploy a WAF (e.g. AWS WAF, Cloudflare) in front of the task server API.

nist-ac-02.name: Account Management
nist-ac-02.description: User accounts are managed with defined roles and reviewed periodically.
nist-ac-02.remediation: Enable RBAC and configure quarterly access reviews.

nist-ac-03.name: Access Enforcement
nist-ac-03.description: Access enforcement mechanisms prevent unauthorised operations.
nist-ac-03.remediation: Enable RBAC. Enforce deny-by-default access policy.

nist-ac-06.name: Least Privilege
nist-ac-06.description: Processes are granted only the minimum privileges required.
nist-ac-06.remediation: Drop container capabilities. Enable seccomp filtering.

nist-ac-17.name: Remote Access Security
nist-ac-17.description: Remote access requires MFA and encrypted sessions.
nist-ac-17.remediation: Require MFA for remote access. Enforce TLS on all connections.

nist-au-02.name: Audit Event Selection
nist-au-02.description: The organisation defines and logs auditable events.
nist-au-02.remediation: Enable audit_logging=true and define which events to capture.

nist-au-03.name: Audit Record Content
nist-au-03.description: Audit records contain sufficient information to reconstruct events.
nist-au-03.remediation: Enable HMAC-chained audit logging for tamper-evident records.

nist-au-09.name: Audit Record Protection
nist-au-09.description: Audit records are protected from unauthorised modification.

nist-au-11.name: Audit Record Retention
nist-au-11.description: Audit logs are retained for a minimum of 3 years for federal contexts.
nist-au-11.remediation: Retain audit logs for at least 365 days (extend to 1095 for federal).

nist-cm-02.name: Baseline Configuration
nist-cm-02.description: A baseline configuration is established and maintained.
nist-cm-02.remediation: Pin all dependencies to exact versions. Use reproducible builds.

nist-cm-07.name: Least Functionality
nist-cm-07.description: Systems are configured to provide only essential capabilities.
nist-cm-07.remediation: Enable container sandbox, seccomp filtering, and network isolation.

nist-ia-02.name: User Identification and Authentication
nist-ia-02.description: Users and agents are uniquely identified and authenticated.
nist-ia-02.remediation: Enforce MFA and RBAC for all identities.

nist-ia-05.name: Authenticator Management
nist-ia-05.description: Credentials are rotated, of sufficient complexity, and protected.
nist-ia-05.remediation: Rotate secrets ≤90 days. Enforce minimum credential length of 12.

nist-ra-05.name: Vulnerability Monitoring
nist-ra-05.description: Systems are scanned for vulnerabilities on a regular basis.
nist-ra-05.remediation: Integrate automated vulnerability scanning into CI/CD.

nist-sc-08.name: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
nist-sc-08.description: Data transmitted over networks is protected against disclosure and modification.
nist-sc-08.remediation: Enforce TLS 1.3. Set tls_enforced=true and encrypt_in_transit=true.

nist-sc-28.name: Protection of Information at Rest
nist-sc-28.description: Information stored at rest is protected using encryption.

nist-si-02.name: Flaw Remediation
nist-si-02.description: Security flaws are identified and corrected in a timely manner.
nist-si-02.remediation: Run automated SAST and vulnerability scanning. Remediate within SLA.

nist-si-03.name: Malicious Code Protection
nist-si-03.description: Mechanisms protect against malicious code at appropriate locations.
nist-si-03.remediation: Container sandboxing and seccomp filtering limit malicious code execution.

nist-si-10.name: Information Input Validation
nist-si-10.description: The system validates information inputs to prevent injection attacks.
nist-si-10.remediation: Deploy WAF and validate all agent task inputs before execution.
